login_subtitle: Use your user account to continue.
login_error_unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
login_error_interrupted: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
login_error_invalid: That username or password was not recognized.
login_error_locked: This account is locked. Contact IT to unlock it.
login_error_disabled: This account is disabled or expired. Contact IT.
login_error_expired: Your password has expired. Change it and try again.
login_error_throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
login_error_no_method: No sign-in method is configured. Contact IT.
publish_hint_private: Internal to the workspace. Publishing exposes it on the public wiki.
workspaces_empty: You don't have access to any workspaces yet.
home_subtitle: You're signed in. The workspace UI lands here next.
error_401_desc: You need to sign in to view this page.
error_403_desc: You don't have permission to view this — it may live in a workspace you're not a member of.
error_404_desc: This page, or the document it points to, doesn't exist.
error_500_desc: An unexpected error occurred on our end.
docs_empty_filtered: No documents match the selected tags.
drafts_hint: Working copies written by an assistant. They stay out of search and are deleted automatically unless you keep them.
doc_delete_confirm: Delete this document? It can be restored from history.
connections_hint: Select a node in the graph to see its connections.
connections_none: No connections yet for this document.
onboarding_welcome_body: Your team’s documents in one place — search, read and keep them current. Let’s set things up in under a minute.
onboarding_appearance_body: You can change any of this later in Settings.
onboarding_tip_search: Press {key} anywhere to search every document.
onboarding_tip_tags: Filter the list by tags from the sidebar; combining tags narrows it.
onboarding_tip_new: Write in markdown and drop in ```typst blocks for tables, formulas and figures.
onboarding_profile_body: Your account comes from the company directory. This is only how Tabula addresses you.
settings_call_you_hint: Used in the sidebar and greetings
templates_body: A template is a Typst document that wraps a page when it is exported to PDF.
template_inputs_hint: Available via sys.inputs: title, slug, author, date, tags, workspace, company, brandName, brandColor.
template_used_by_frontmatter: Set template: {slug} in a document’s front matter to make it the default for that document.
template_default_desc: Plain layout: no cover, no header, just the document.
login_error_not_allowed: You don't have access to Tabula. Contact IT to request it.
admin_subtitle: Create workspaces, decide who gets in, and set the rules that apply inside each one.
admin_ws_id_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It appears in every URL and cannot be changed later.
admin_delete_ws_hint: Deletes the workspace along with every document, version and attachment in it. This cannot be undone.
admin_access_hint: Someone reaches this workspace if any rule below matches their directory attributes. When several match, the highest role wins.
admin_access_empty: No rules yet — only platform admins can reach this workspace.
admin_access_central: Membership is managed by platform admins.
admin_platform_subtitle: Who may sign in, and every account that has.
admin_gate_hint: Rules decide who may sign in at all, using the same selectors as workspace access. With no rules, anyone who authenticates may enter. Platform admins always enter.
admin_gate_empty: No rules — anyone who authenticates may sign in.
admin_users_hint: Everyone who has signed in at least once. Blocking takes effect immediately, including open sessions and API tokens.
admin_users_empty: No one has signed in yet.
admin_user_delete_confirm: Delete this user and their personal workspace? This cannot be undone.
tokens_hint: Personal access for integrations — PerguntAI, MCP clients, scripts. A token acts with the permissions you have when it is created.
tokens_label_placeholder: What is this token for? e.g. perguntai
tokens_created_note: Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
wiki_subtitle: Everything published for the whole organization.
editor_error_publish_forbidden: You can't publish docs in this workspace.
admin_public_hint: Everything on the wiki, with views over the last 30 days.
admin_policy_editor_hint: Viewers always read and maintainers always do everything, so only the editor role is configurable.
admin_allow_public_hint: With this off, nothing here can be reached without signing in — whatever a document is marked as. Turn it on only for workspaces whose content may leave the company.
admin_review_off_hint: Changes take effect the moment they are saved.
admin_review_new_hint: A new document waits for approval; later edits to it go live directly.
admin_review_all_hint: Every change waits for approval before readers see it.
admin_approvers_hint: Leave this empty and the workspace maintainers approve. Add rules to widen it to named people, an AD group or a cost center.
admin_quorum_bound_min: {count} named, plus anyone matching a group rule
admin_quorum_deadlock: That is more approvals than there are people who can give them — reviews would never finish.
admin_approve_public_hint: Applies even when nothing else is reviewed, because anonymous exposure cannot be taken back. Un-publishing is always immediate.
admin_self_approve: Approvers may approve their own changes
admin_viewers_propose_hint: Lets someone without edit rights submit a change for review. Needs review to be switched on.
admin_error_invalid_id: That identifier is not valid. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
admin_error_exists: A workspace with that identifier already exists.
error_400_desc: Something in that request was not valid. Check the values and try again.
error_409_desc: Something with that name or identifier is already there.
error_413_desc: That upload exceeds the size this server accepts.
error_422_desc: The request was understood but the content could not be used — often a template that fails to compile.
error_429_desc: You have made a lot of requests in a short time. Wait a moment and retry.
error_503_desc: A service this page depends on is not responding. It should recover shortly.
error_4xx_desc: That request could not be completed.
error_5xx_desc: Something failed on our side. Retrying often works; if it does not, send the reference below to IT.
